notes: Development-only oracle-family complementary-coverage gate. Clients receive noisy finite one-step perturbation data at one speed block. Local is the locally identifiable physics span L=3. LocalRegularized uses L=7 with a local L=3 prior and leave-one-speed-out ridge selection. Global and FamilyPool fit shared L=7 maps. FamilyPersonalized regularizes each L=7 client map toward its oracle-family backbone with local validation. LocalFull uses recipient-local data over the full speed grid with the same total transition count as one family pool. ExactLPV fits L=7 to exact recipient Jacobians. Evaluation uses exact held-out matrices and nonlinear recovery simulations only after fitting. Outside its calibrated block, Local and LocalRegularized use the safe nearest-calibrated-speed controller rather than attempting controller synthesis from an unsupported extrapolation; their prediction metric still measures the actual unseen-speed model error. The primary gate is paired fleet-level superiority of FamilyPersonalized over Local on locally unseen speeds in prediction and nonlinear control, with all controllers feasible. No clustering or federated optimizer is claimed.
